description: Consumer rule for an unknown format id (plugin-protocol.md section 5.5.1). BinaryFormat is marked x-slopvac-extensible, so a later host may send an id that an older plugin does not know. The plugin declines that document with binary-input-declined (-32008), data.reason unknown-format, and answers the others; it does not fail the request with invalid-params. A strict schema check of the request reports an error only at unknown_format_pointer, the extensible position. Manifest validation stays strict: a manifest that declares the same id is refused at manifest_pointer. The host adds binary-input-declined to the unchecked list of d2, so that run exits 2; this vector checks the plugin side.

error.message: format vsdx is not one this extractor knows
